public.title: Course Schedule II
public.description: There are n courses numbered 0 through n-1. Each pair [course, prerequisite] requires the second course first. Return the lexicographically smallest valid course order, or [] when a cycle makes completion impossible. n is 0 to 100; prerequisites has at most 500 distinct pairs of different valid course IDs.
hints: Among currently available courses, always choose the smallest ID.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Kahn topological sorting with smallest-ready selection gives the lexicographically smallest valid order. Sorting the ready set is acceptable at these bounds.
